philosophy.title: Minimalism First
philosophy.description: Code should be as simple as possible, but no simpler. I ruthlessly eliminate complexity and focus on clean, maintainable architecture.

philosophy.title: Data-Driven AI
philosophy.description: I believe in building AI systems that solve real problems. A great model is useless without exceptional data engineering and a flawless user experience.

philosophy.title: Invisible Polish
philosophy.description: The difference between good and great is in the details nobody consciously notices. Perfect spacing, strict typography, and calm motion.
